notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]Thorian Games and Goblinz Publishing are thrilled to announce that a brand-new demo for Decks of the Damned is out now! 🔥[/p][p][i]Command your vampire minions, scavenge gear from fallen foes and craft powerful items to strenghten your forces. Defend by day, expand your domain by night, and shroud the land in darkness![/i][/p][previewyoutube="Lbk8RK1lzE0;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]MULTIPLE VAMPIRE CLASSES[/b][/h3][p]Discover powerful classes, each with its own unique playstyle. Tame monsters, brew potions and craft magic weapons to gain the upper hand in combat. Tailor your strategy around your undead army. Unique synergies arise depending on whether your minions are slow, sturdy juggernauts or swift, delicate fighters.[/p][h3][b]EXPLORE THE LAND[/b][/h3][p]Journey through a changing world filled with hidden villages and kingdoms to raid. Each area offers new resources to find and different enemies to fight. Random events like traveling merchants, bandit raids, and snowstorms keep each playthrough fresh and exciting. In addition, Mysterious artifacts lie hidden across the realm. Complete special challenges to uncover their locations.[/p][h3][b]REBUILD YOUR CASTLE[/b][/h3][p]Your castle lies in ruins. Design a unique castle that unlocks lasting bonuses and powerful upgrades.[/p][h3][b]VARIATION IN STRATEGY[/b][/h3][p]Discover a large number of powerful effects embedded in weapons and equipment, allowing you to shape your own unique playstyle. Experiment with different combinations and uncover exciting synergies, ensuring every battle stays fresh and rewarding.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Try out the demo now[/u]:[/h2][h2][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171380/Decks_of_the_Damned_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Announcement: Play the Demo!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Decks of the Damned is now available as a demo on Itch.io !
Step into the dark realm to raise an undead army and challenge the dominance of the living who seek to destroy you.

As this is our first demo release, please be aware that some bugs may still be present. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to your feedback as you conquer the living!

Link to demo: [url=https://codearcs.itch.io/decks-of-the-damned]https://codearcs.itch.io/decks-of-the-damned[/url]

notes.title: Decks of the Damned public demo in August!
notes.notes:
Get ready for the first public demo for Decks of the Damned in August. The demo will contain the tutorial missions as well as the main game mode called Conqest.

In Conquest, your goal is to locate hidden human villages and raid them on a procedurally generated map. Each map tile type contains unique resources and challenges, as well as random events that may trigger as you progress through the game. As you raid villages, you unlock permanent progression content such as new crafting recipes and mysterious artifact quests.
